The complete runtime presentation snapshot is app visibility alone. Other
 fields, including the retired `audio_route`, are ignored. Horizontal center as a fraction of the portrait width. Vertical center as a fraction of the portrait height. Square side length as a fraction of the portrait width. Square framing in a full call portrait, the same shape as a call join's
 `call_portrait.display_crop`. The light portrait's shared square crop, present with `light`, for
 framing the 7:12 clip in a call circle before the call joins. The dark portrait's call square, present with `dark`; Coop zooms the
 7:12 clip from a wider rest framing to it as a call starts. Saved light idle recipe ID, separate from the portrait recipe.minLengthmaxLengthpatternminimum Saved dark idle recipe ID, separate from the portrait recipe. Pumpkin idle clips made from the call portraits, each the full 7:12 frame;
 Hatch plays `light` and Coop plays `dark` before live call video starts. Workspace-relative path of the saved portrait under
 `workspace/avatars/`, for debugging. Clients do not render it. Descriptive metadata for newly published generated call portraits. Whether calls with this avatar can use live video. Clients play a call
 idle clip only when true. Absent until the avatar's traits are
 classified. The revision of `GET /api/avatar/assets`, present only while the
 owner passes `abra_hatch_avatar_assets_api`. Absent: use the fields
 above. Local filesystem path to the episode audio (manifest `path` field). Spotify episode URI (`spotify:episode:<id>`) when the episode was saved
 to the user's personal Spotify show. The speaker-labeled source script the episode audio was synthesized from.
 Returned only by the single-episode GET; omitted from list responses so a
 listing never carries every episode's full script. A short summary of the major topics and key points this episode covered,
 so a future generation can read prior coverage and avoid repeating it.
 Small enough to be returned by list responses as well as the single GET. A podcast episode catalog entry. Field names mirror the legacy manifest.json
 episode shape so the in-cell helper can round-trip episode records directly. Public URL of the user's personal Spotify show
 (`https://open.spotify.com/show/<id>`), when episodes were saved there. One feed this VM publishes into. Field names mirror the legacy
 manifest.json `feed{}` shape. Optional filters for the episodes list. At most one identifier is applied,
 in precedence order: `episode_url` (resolves a single episode), then
 `feed_url`, then `feed_id` (both return that feed's episodes). With none set,

 against the content -- an inference outage or an unreachable Sentinel.
